name: Local Plan (Core Strategy and Placemaking Plan) Partial Update
organisation-name: Bath and North East Somerset Council

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Bath and North East Somerset Council
housing-numbers.notes: Original 2014 core strategy, with a plan period of 2011-2029, was partially updated in 2023. Required housing is 'around 13,000 homes'. Allocated housing includes 980 existing allocations plus 940 new allocations through LPPU. Committed housing includes completions (2011-2022) of 8,784 plus extant permissions of 2,900, totaling 11,684.
